title: Painting Services | Rosa's Sparkling Clean & Management
metaDescription: Interior and exterior painting — touch-ups, full rooms and full exteriors — for listings, rentals and vacant properties in Ocala, Tampa and Spring Hill, FL.
h1: A fresh coat sells faster than a fresh excuse.
intro: A faded exterior or scuffed walls are one of the first things a buyer notices and one of the fastest things to fix. We handle touch-ups, full rooms and full exteriors with the same crew doing the rest of the prep.
heroVideoAlt: Before and after comparison of a house exterior: faded, stained stucco on the left, freshly painted grey exterior with a tidied driveway on the right
heroImageAlt: A painter rolling white paint onto an interior wall
whatsappMessage: Hi, I'd like to ask about your painting service

cta.heading: Send us a photo of the wall
cta.body: A quick photo on WhatsApp is all we need to quote touch-ups or a full room.

sections.heading: What's included
items: Touch-ups on scuffs and nail holes

sections.heading: Who it's for
sections.body: Sellers repainting before listing photos, landlords turning over a rental, and owners of vacant homes whose exterior has faded from sitting empty.

evidence.heading: See the difference
evidence.alt: Before and after comparison of a house exterior: faded, stained stucco on the left, freshly painted grey exterior with a tidied driveway on the right
evidence.caption: Same house, one paint job — curb appeal a listing photo can actually sell.
